const r = await tools.exec_command({
  cmd: "set -eu
window='evidence/quality/repair-window-54-20260929'
manifest='.ai/task/repair-w54-20260929/PACK-MANIFEST.json'
count=0
while IFS='	' read -r rel expected; do dst="$window/orchestration/$rel"; test -f "$dst"; actual=$(sha256sum "$dst" | cut -d' ' -f1); test "$actual" = "$expected"; count=$((count + 1)); done < <(jq -r '.files[] | [.relative_destination,.sha256] | @tsv' "$manifest")
test "$count" -eq 145
cmp -s "$manifest" "$window/orchestration-pack-manifest.json"
candidate='.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window54-20260929-candidate-catalog'
candidate_count=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' src; do rel=${src#"$candidate/"}; cmp -s "$src" "$rel"; candidate_count=$((candidate_count + 1)); done < <(find "$candidate" -type f -print0)
test "$candidate_count" -eq 5
cmp -s .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window54-20260929-migration.json evidence/production-review-v2-lite/migrations/f990cf25e98ce2a0759cf48eb673acb91324a1ecc8597632cb27d2cb0054e7a1.json
publication="$window/publication"
cmp -s .ai/task/repair-w54-20260929/PUBLICATION-SCOPE.md "$publication/PUBLICATION-SCOPE.md"
cmp -s .ai/task/repair-w54-20260929/CATALOG-CHANGE-VERIFICATION.json "$publication/CATALOG-CHANGE-VERIFICATION.json"
cmp -s .ai/task/repair-w54-20260929/MIGRATION-HOST-VERIFICATION.json "$publication/MIGRATION-HOST-VERIFICATION.json"
cmp -s .ai/task/repair-w54-20260929/TRANSLATION-COMMIT.json "$publication/TRANSLATION-COMMIT.json"
for name in ADJUDICATION-F2.json ADJUDICATION-R0.json ADJUDICATION-R1.json ADJUDICATION-R2.json; do cmp -s ".ai/task/repair-w54-20260929/$name" "$publication/$name"; done
cmp -s .artifacts/i18n/repair-w54-20260929/HOST-SUPPLEMENT-CLAIMS.json "$publication/HOST-SUPPLEMENT-CLAIMS.json"
cmp -s .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window54-20260929-publish-chain.log "$publication/publish-chain.log"
cmp -s .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window54-20260929-publish-chain-timing.json "$publication/publish-chain-timing.json"
cmp -s .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window54-20260929-migration.json "$publication/migration.json"
cmp -s .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window54-20260929-migration-timing.json "$publication/migration-timing.json"
iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 handoff.md >/dev/null
iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 "$window/PUBLICATION.md" >/dev/null
git diff --check
printf 'pack_items=%s catalog_files=%s exact_copies=OK utf8=OK whitespace=OK\n' "$count" "$candidate_count"
git diff -- handoff.md
printf '\nCHANGED_TRACKED\n'
git status --short --untracked-files=all | sed -n '1,240p'",
  workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
  yield_time_ms: 10000,
  max_output_tokens: 40000,
  sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated",

});
text(r.output);
